Build clean, exit 0. Two real bugs, deprecation noise stays (harmless).

- `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, new bundler shape is `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined` flag (new loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`). Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

Rest of warnings (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267, unused-export, circular-import, `crypto.createCipher`) are just log noise from the fake bundler, not blockers — link stage passes.
